newsitem.title: UK: Finnish study finds no cancer link to power lines.
newsitem.headline: Finnish study finds no cancer link to power lines.

text.p: Finnish researchers reported on Friday they had found no link between high-voltage power lines and cancer in adults as some health monitors have feared.
A study of nearly 400,000 people living near power lines showed they actually had fewer cases of cancer than would have been expected, the report in the British Medical Journal found.
Researchers have been trying to pin down suspicions that the electromagnetic radiation coming from power lines and even from appliances can cause cancer. But scientific findings conflict.

Dr Pia Verkasalo and colleagues at Helsinki University's department of health looked at records dating back to 1970 and found only 8,415 cases of cancer among the people living under high-voltage power lines. Statistics would normally predict 8,587 cases.
